description: Search designmark.jp for DESIGN.md design systems of Japanese landing pages (LP): unofficial analyses of public Japanese LPs (colors, typography, spacing, components, section structure), plus CC BY 4.0 pattern packs synthesised per industry and mood. Filter by keywords (Japanese or English), industry, mood, main color and view. Returns one line per design: ID | title | industry | moods | main colors | page URL. Then fetch the chosen design with get_design (xd-…) or get_pack (pk-…). Searching reads a cached index and does not count toward the fetch limit (30 DESIGN.md fetches per 10 minutes).

category.description: Industry name or slug, e.g. "cosmetics" or "化粧品・スキンケア"

color.description: Main color family (LP designs only): red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray, white, or a Japanese name such as 青

moods.description: Mood names or slugs, all of which must match: natural, soft, elegant, minimal, pop, retro, cute, sporty, cool, dark-luxury, trust, handmade, wafu, fresh, bold, dense

query.description: Keywords, all of which must match, e.g. "化粧品 上品" or "skincare"

view.description: Analysed view (LP designs only): sp = smartphone, pc = desktop

name: search_designs
title: Search Japanese LP designs
